decisions.reason: Organic vegan superfood drink mix is a peripheral consumer product outside the core waste-to-energy technology portfolio, and after four years without evidence of traction it is likely to be dropped to free resources for core options.
Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions are complementary to the firm's core plants and can be kept at low cost while uncertainty about demand resolves, so the option is retained.
As a flagship waste oil to energy plant, it has high strategic option value and the firm continues to invest as uncertainty resolves.
As a flagship plastic waste to fuel plant, it has high strategic option value and the firm continues to invest as uncertainty resolves.
